# User Interface.zip - Asset Descriptions

This archive is a collection of pixel-art UI kits including controller buttons, keyboards, inventory panels, sci-fi inventory panels, and a comprehensive GUI kit with multiple styles.

## Controller Buttons 16x16 Pixelart

- UI_Gamepad.png: full controller sprite sheet.
- UI_Gamepad_01_Buttons.png, UI_Gamepad_01_Cross.png through UI_Gamepad_04_Buttons.png and Cross variants: separate button sheets and directional cross sprites for four controller styles.

## Free Inventory

- Inventory_background.png: background panel.
- Inventory_Bar.png, Inventory_Slot.png: hotbar and slot elements.
- Inventory_select.png: selected-slot highlight.
- Inventory_style_01a through 01d, 02a through 02d, 03a through 03d: 12 inventory panel style variants.
- License.txt: usage terms.

## Free SciFi Inventory

- Inventory Boxes/ folder: scifi_inventory01.png, scifi_inventory02.png, plus box, back, and select variants for each.
- Inventory_Example_01.png through 06.png: six example composed inventories.
- Read Me.txt: usage instructions.

## GUI Kit Pixelart Asset Pack

- Icons Sprite Sheets/ folder: Icons 16x16 Transparent.png and Icons 32x32 Style 01.png through 04.png.
- Icons Style 1/ folder: Style 1 Icon 000.png through ~200.png.
- Icons Style 2/, Style 3/, Style 4/ folders: matching icon sets.
- User Interface 01/ through User Interface 04/ folders: panel and window art for each style.

## Keyboard UI 16x16 Pixelart Asset Pack

- Keyboard_UI.png: full keyboard sprite sheet.
- Keyboard_UI_Black_Animated.png, Keyboard_UI_White_Animated.png: animated black and white key sets.
- 32x32/ folder: 32x32 scaled keyboard sprites.
- Animated Frames/ folder: per-key animation frames.
- Unity/ folder: Unity import package.

## Retro Inventory

- Original/ folder: retro-style inventory panels, slots, and icons.
- Scaled 2x/ folder: 2x resolution variants.
- Scaled 3x/ folder: 3x resolution variants.
- Read Me.txt: usage instructions.

## Notes

This archive contains UI panels, icons, controllers, and keyboards only. There are no character, monster, or creature sprites in this pack.

Review heuristics: “grid does not divide dimensions evenly” means the declared cell width or height leaves a remainder. “Fully transparent frame” means every pixel in a grid frame has zero alpha. “Edge-continuation suspect” compares each frame’s right edge with the next frame’s first three columns and flags repeated rows where the current edge is opaque while the neighbor edge is at least 75% transparent. These warnings are simple review cues, not decisions.
